title: Visualization:  Hierarchical Navigable Small World
description: An interactive 3D visualization of FAISS’s HNSW search algorithm that makes high-dimensional vector search easier to understand. I modified FAISS to record visited nodes during search, built a Python/Flask pipeline to generate embeddings and HNSW indexes for Gutenberg and Wikipedia datasets, and used PCA/UMAP for projection. The React and Three.js frontend lets users explore graph layers, run text searches, and visualize the query and search path in 3D.
